task.summary: Started implementing background-per-slice option for MUSE pixtables.
Continued implementing background-per-slice option for MUSE pixtables.
Finished initial implementation of background-per-slice option for MUSE pixtables.
Fixed bug that INITFIT failed when aperture photometry returned only NaNs for one source.
Previous fix did not do the job, hope this one does.
Previous fix did not do the job, hope this one does.
Adapted writing of spectra so that S/N and magnitudes are not calculated for background components. Also fixed bug that wavelength array was not included in spectra anymore.
Fixed bugs in POLYFIT
Fixed bug.
Fixed bug.

Fixed bug.

Modifications to GUI. Should not crash anymore when layer in NaD gap is selected.
Last fix was not successful.
Last fix was still not successful.
Continued working on supersampling of background
Fixed bug that evaluation of polynomial position fits produced bogus results because wavelength scale was changed.
Slight change so that old column names for polynomial fits to positions are recognized again.
Still experiencing issues with wavelength scale. Hopefully this fixes them.

Fixed bug in SINGLESRC routine. Also fixed issue that setting cpucount=-1 caused aperture photometry to crash. Finally, added handling for cases where total flux on integrated IFS image was still negative after subtracting median flux.
Fixed bug that when a mask for MUSE cubes was provided, only masked pixels were used.
Fixed bug in INITFIT occurring when n_cpu was None or -1. Also revised correction for negative fluxes in integrated IFU image.
Fixed bug that CUBEFIT crashed if only PSF parameters or positions were fitted.
Fixed bug in CUBEFIT and applied patch for images created from cubes with negative backgrounds in INITFIT.
Added polynom mask to list of changeable parameters.
Added new configuration parameters usesigma and psfmag to initfit-section
Added some logging
Adopted new wavelength policy: Internally, meters are used, but I/O is in Angstrom.
Fixed bug in GETSPECTRA.
Fixed another bug in GETSPECTRA.
Corrected logging message
Revised wavelength array calculation
Again working on WCS and wavelength units
Recognizing extension 'data_quality' as bad-pixel mask
Revised definition of FoV edge for pixtables.
Minor bugfix affecting the creation of the PSF diagnostics file. Also minor change in documentation.

Fixed rather serious bug in CUBEFIT that source coordinates where not properly updated when more than one CPU was used. This may affect all analyses performed with SVN revision 425 (committed 2017/05/28) or later that did not use a coordinate transformation or used polynomial fits to the coordinates.
Switched off local background determination for single PSF fits in CUBEFIT. The old approach (introduced in the revision committed on 2017/05/28) lead to increased beta values for a Moffat PSF.
